scenarios.title: Indirect prompt-injection-shaped retrieved context
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted retrieved context is modeled as attempting to influence a mock external action.
scenarios.rationale: External content must remain untrusted and must not directly authorize an outbound action.

references.title: MITRE ATLAS AML.T0051.001 LLM Prompt Injection: Indirect

scenarios.title: Direct prompt-injection-shaped privileged request
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted input is modeled as requesting a sensitive mock data action.
scenarios.rationale: A request classified as untrusted must not gain direct access to sensitive capabilities.

references.title: MITRE ATLAS AML.T0051.000 LLM Prompt Injection: Direct

scenarios.title: Tool-description poisoning-shaped outbound request
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted tool metadata is modeled as attempting to broaden an external mock action.
scenarios.rationale: MCP tool annotations and descriptions are metadata, not authorization; untrusted declarations need explicit policy control.

scenarios.title: Confused-deputy-shaped cross-boundary action
scenarios.description: Synthetic conditionally trusted context is modeled as reaching a mock external action through an intermediary decision.
scenarios.rationale: Conditional context requires a documented approval boundary before a high-impact external action.

references.title: OWASP AI Agent Security Cheat Sheet

scenarios.title: Sensitive-information-disclosure-shaped route
scenarios.description: Synthetic conditional confidential context is modeled as influencing an external mock recipient route.
scenarios.rationale: A data-disclosure-shaped route should require explicit human approval rather than an automatic outbound decision.

scenarios.title: Excessive-agency-shaped capability request
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted context is modeled as attempting to invoke an external mock action outside its permitted scope.
scenarios.rationale: Least-privilege architecture keeps untrusted context from directly expanding an agent’s action authority.

scenarios.title: System-prompt-leakage-shaped sensitive access
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted context is modeled as attempting to trigger a sensitive mock data action.
scenarios.rationale: Prompt or configuration disclosure risk does not grant authority to access protected data.

scenarios.title: Vector-retrieval-weakness-shaped sensitive route
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted retrieved content is modeled as influencing a sensitive mock operation.
scenarios.rationale: Retrieved content must remain segregated from authority to invoke sensitive actions.

references.title: OWASP LLM08:2025 Vector and Embedding Weaknesses

scenarios.title: Supply-chain-metadata-shaped external capability
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted integration metadata is modeled as attempting to authorize an external mock action.
scenarios.rationale: Third-party metadata must be reviewed as a declared trust boundary, not treated as an authority grant.

scenarios.title: High-impact approval-bypass-shaped path
scenarios.description: Synthetic conditionally trusted context is modeled as requesting a mock external action that has a declared approval boundary.
scenarios.rationale: High-impact actions need an explicit approval decision rather than automatic execution from conditionally trusted context.

references.title: OWASP AI Agent Security Cheat Sheet

scenarios.title: MCP tool-list drift-shaped external action
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted changed tool metadata is modeled as reaching a mock external action.
scenarios.rationale: A changed tool list is review metadata and cannot automatically expand authority.

scenarios.title: Tool-name-collision-shaped sensitive action
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted integration metadata reuses a familiar tool label for a mock sensitive action.
scenarios.rationale: Tool names and descriptions cannot substitute for explicit trust mapping and policy review.

references.title: OWASP AI Agent Security Cheat Sheet

scenarios.title: Supplier-provenance-drift-shaped capability request
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted supplier metadata is modeled as requesting a mock external capability.
scenarios.rationale: Third-party provenance changes require review and do not grant a new action path.

scenarios.title: MCP tool redefinition-shaped sensitive route
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted replacement tool metadata requests a mock sensitive action.
scenarios.rationale: A declared tool change requires review and cannot retain prior authority by name alone.

scenarios.title: Open-world hint-shaped outbound route
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted annotation metadata requests a mock external action.
scenarios.rationale: Tool annotations are metadata rather than a policy authorization grant.

scenarios.title: Resource-link-shaped sensitive disclosure
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted linked context requests a mock sensitive action.
scenarios.rationale: A resource link must remain untrusted until a declared review boundary is satisfied.

references.title: OWASP AI Agent Security Cheat Sheet

scenarios.title: Multi-agent delegation-shaped external action
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted delegated context requests a mock external action.
scenarios.rationale: Delegation cannot cross a trust boundary without explicit authorization and review.

references.title: OWASP AI Agent Security Cheat Sheet

scenarios.title: Approval-record manipulation-shaped action
scenarios.description: Synthetic conditional context requests a mock external action through an approval boundary.
scenarios.rationale: High-impact approvals must stay bound and fail closed rather than becoming automatic execution.

references.title: OWASP AI Agent Security Cheat Sheet

scenarios.title: Typosquatted tool-name-shaped route
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted similar-name metadata requests a mock external action.
scenarios.rationale: Similarity of a tool name is not identity, provenance, or authorization evidence.

scenarios.title: Capability-growth-shaped sensitive route
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted change metadata requests a mock sensitive action.
scenarios.rationale: New declared capability scope requires review and cannot be authorized by stale policy assumptions.

references.title: OWASP AI Agent Security Cheat Sheet

scenarios.title: Tool-result poisoning-shaped outbound request
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted tool-result metadata requests a mock external action.
scenarios.rationale: Tool results are data and must not independently authorize downstream actions.

references.title: OWASP AI Agent Security Cheat Sheet

scenarios.title: Memory-poisoning-shaped sensitive route
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted persisted context requests a mock sensitive action.
scenarios.rationale: Persisted context must not convert untrusted content into privileged authority.

references.title: OWASP AI Agent Security Cheat Sheet

scenarios.title: Supplier-maintenance-drift-shaped external route
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted outdated supplier metadata requests a mock external action.
scenarios.rationale: Supplier maintenance state and metadata require explicit review rather than implicit trust.

scenarios.title: Human-preview-bypass-shaped action
scenarios.description: Synthetic conditional context requests a mock external action without a completed review.
scenarios.rationale: A conditional high-impact action stays pending human approval rather than becoming automatic.

references.title: OWASP AI Agent Security Cheat Sheet

scenarios.title: Cross-server tool confusion-shaped sensitive action
scenarios.description: Synthetic untrusted cross-server metadata requests a mock sensitive action.
scenarios.rationale: A tool reference must be explicitly mapped; server context and a familiar label are insufficient.
